Hi Alex / Priya —

Great speaking with you earlier in the discovery. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive to walk through Redwood's architecture, integration patterns (API + streaming + embeddings), and capacity planning for your multi-tenant inference needs. Suggested agenda:

- 5m intros
- 15m recap of your architecture & goals
- 30m proposed integration options (API, Dedicated, Private) + performance/cost tradeoffs
- 10m next steps / MOPs

I have the following windows next week (PST):
- Tue 9/14: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 9/15: 11:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:00

If none of those work, share a couple of slots that fit your calendar and we'll accommodate. Marcus (solutions architect) will join for the deep-dive and Rachel will help to follow up on any security/compliance asks afterwards.

Attaching a short pre-read and our architecture questionnaire to help us tailor the session.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Enterprise Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
